signal: Representative sample of the persistent MSUSD/USDC arb that fired every block for ~2 hours during the pre-index-fix window of EXP-001. Chosen as a calibration example because it is the dominant pattern in our first dataset.
reasoning: Speaks to H1 because it represents the lower bound of intra-chain opportunity rate on Base — even on a structurally clean monitored set, at least one persistent inefficiency exists at >=0.3% margin. Speaks to H3 because this exact opportunity (Aerodrome Slipstream MSUSD/USDC CL50 ↔ Aerodrome stable MSUSD/USDC, borrowed USDC) had ZERO flag fires across 2,420 emissions — supports the H3 prediction that flagged vs unflagged distributions differ on protocol-combo and token-identity (this one IS the unflagged distribution). Does NOT speak to H2 because every evaluation was layer3_stale=True (UNK-005).

postmortem: Hypothesis attribution held up. If a similar pattern emerges on a new pool pair, it would be worth annotating again to confirm; if MSUSD/USDC reopens, log only the FIRST reopening as a new event_id annotation, not every subsequent emission.
